about: Deliberate icon reuse (design system §4.3 and K69). Every texture that serves more than one concept must be covered by one entry here, or check 10 (icon.registry) reports it. Kinds: same_concept, tiers, family_badge, engine_fallback, general_focus. Hand-kept: add an entry with its reason before two concepts share a picture; general_focus entries are proposed by the lead from the rule below and confirmed by the owner.
generalFocusRule: A focus is genuinely general when two or more focus trees carry a focus with the same localised name and the same template slug (the id is <tree file stem>_<slug>); every copy is the same story branch, so one icon serves all of them. Nothing else shares a focus icon.

focus.rule: one icon per focus; the general focus groups below share one icon each (K69)

spirit.rule: one picture per national spirit; a spirit granted by a same-named focus may reuse that focus art recut to the idea frame (same_concept, recorded as a share)

law.rule: one picture per law (economy, trade, mobilisation)

decision.rule: one seal per decision or mission

decision_category_picture.rule: one picture per category that has a picture

event.rule: one picture per visible event; events that show the same moment (a follow-up of one scene) may share it as same_concept, recorded per chain by lane I10

equipment.rule: one picture per equipment type; marks of one line use the tiers rule (one base picture with a tier mark, own sprite per mark)

subunit.rule: one unit icon per sub-unit, including the 20 without an icon today

trait.rule: one emblem per unit leader and country leader trait

doctrine.rule: one plate per grand doctrine, track and sub-doctrine (own art exists, K51/K58)

faction.rule: one shield per faction template, in both engine sizes

map_mode.rule: one button per ZIN map mode, with distinct selected and deselected frames

resource.rule: one frame per resource in the engine strip

super_event.rule: one painted moment per super event
